description: Returns the blocks of a daily-style (append-only) page, oldest to newest, optionally for one date. If the HTML of every block does not fit in the response it is omitted (htmlOmitted) and one block can be fetched with `blockId`. Another user's daily page comes with thirdParty and thirdPartyNotice (third-party content). Read-only.

blockId.description: Id of one block (blk_…): returns only that block, with its full HTML

includeHtml.description: false = metadata only (id, ts, label, size, author), without HTML. Omitted = with HTML when it fits in the response

user.description: Page owner username (default: the connected account)

name: outbox_get_blocks
title: Outbox: blocks of a daily page
